company.name: Fortress Group
company.about: Fortress Group is a distinguished real estate company in Bangladesh, dedicated to upholding high standards and delivering exceptional quality. With a portfolio of over 35 residential projects situated in prime locations throughout Dhaka, we pride ourselves on ensuring client satisfaction and building lasting relationships with more than 500 clients. Our commitment to top-tier construction and premium finishing sets us apart in the industry, as we continue to contribute positively to the urban landscape.
company.mission: To build safe, innovative, and sustainable developments that enhance lifestyles and communities. Fortress Group is committed to delivering excellence in design, construction, and customer experience through integrity and long-term value.
company.vision: To become a trusted leader in the real estate and development sector by shaping modern urban living with quality, reliability, and forward-thinking solutions.

projects.name: Fortress Primrose
description: The home features private entry copper-clad door leading to salon with marble floors. Stunning great room has soaring 45 foot ceilings with glass windows, polished concrete floors, exposed brick & sculptural steel beams. The chef’s kitchen has honed granite counters, high-end S/S appliances, French cabinets & gas range.

Floor-to-ceiling windows accentuate the panoramic vistas that sweep across the Golden Gate Bridge, the downtown skyline, the artfully lit Bay Bridge and beyond. The floor plan features two bedroom suites, kitchen, living/dining room, two view terraces and ample storage space.

directors.name: Md Gious Uddin
bio: Md. Gious Uddin is a prominent entrepreneur, insightful business mentor, and market specialist with extensive experience in the real estate industry. As the founder of Fortress Holdings Ltd. and Fortress Real Estate Ltd., he has rapidly established a solid foundation for success.

With visionary experience and creative insights, Fortress consistently delivers authentic, high-quality products and services that elevate the living experience. The reputation of Fortress stands as a beacon of strong ethics and an unwavering commitment to quality, innovation, and social responsibility.

We invite you to explore our company, projects, and business philosophy through our website and social media platforms. His mission is to create high-quality, exclusive apartment complexes in prime locations across Dhaka City and other major cities in Bangladesh.

Md. Gious Uddin is also a proud member of the Lions Club. He studied at the Department of Chemistry at Jagannath University and earned his LLB and LLM from Daffodil International University (DIU). As a responsible corporate citizen, he champions sustainable practices that significantly reduce our environmental footprint, believing that real estate development should serve the present while paving the way for future generations. His dedication to this vision encompasses everything from energy-efficient designs to eco-friendly construction.
His promises to customers are simple: transparency, integrity, and excellence in all endeavors.

directors.name: Esrat Jahan
bio: Alhamdulillah, symbols of integrity, trust, and reliability, Fortress Holdings Limited and Fortress Real Estate Limited have already established themselves in the housing sector, consistently delivering customer satisfaction. The company is committed to establishing a unique paradigm in housing, property management, land development, and logistics services, introducing a new concept to the housing sector.

Our principal asset is integrity & honesty. Ensuring quality while maintaining integrity and trust. In this moment of facing the challenges of globalisation, honesty, integrity, sincerity, soundness of mind, and constant hard work will lead us to the gold rush of success. A safe and quality home anchors happiness, peace, prosperity and dreams in a busy life. Therefore, we are cautious in its construction, economical, and work tirelessly with skilled architects, engineers, and skilled workers to build quality houses as per the customer’s demand.

Our main goal is to give the best gift possible. Many of our ongoing projects bear their bright signature. Some more good projects are upcoming. We are one of the best in terms of quality. Quality, luxury, and features such as architecture, interior design, and creative materials reflect a high-class lifestyle. Most of our projects in Dhaka Cantonment, Bashundhara R/A, Mirpur, Uttara, and Jolshori are captivating customers with their unique beauty, standing out among spectacular, breathtaking, and enchanting projects.

The global outlook for the real estate industry is undergoing rapid change. Bangladesh is also moving forward with other countries of the world. Ultimately, we can say that where trust and faith are unwavering, our company plays a key role in creating excellent financial and qualitative opportunities for our customers.

directors.name: Dr. Mohammed Fazl-E-Akbar Chowdhury
bio: Dr Mohammed Fazl-E-Akbar Chowdhury was born in Chittagong Port in 1967. He completed his MBBS at Chittagong Medical College in 1992 and joined the Malaysian Trade Centre as Deputy Chief. In 1995, he bound for KSA and continued until 2017. He completed his MBA (Health Care Services) from Manipal University, India, in 2009. His tenure of more than two decades in the Arabian Peninsula was primarily spent working in the field of basic human needs, including health and shelter. He is the founder of the UAE-based online hotel booking company City-Booking.com. He is the Director of Chattagram Metropolitan Hospital Ltd. and Cox’s Bazar-based real estate business Annoydhara Properties Ltd.

With his versatile experience in both the home and abroad, he joined Fortress Holdings Ltd. and Fortress Real Estate Ltd., with a genuine commitment to providing an excellent, eco-friendly, economical, and durable dream home for all classes of people in Bangladesh.

directors.name: Lt Col Mustafizur Rahman (Retd)
bio: Lt Col Mustafizur Rahman (Retd) is currently the Director (Operation) and Chief Engineer of Fortress Holdings Ltd. & Fortress Real Estate Ltd. With his technical acumen and vast experience, he is the epitome of excellence and dependability. He joined the Bangladesh Army in 1986. He did his Bachelor’s in Science from Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET) in Civil Engineering in 1999. He did his Master’s in Defence Studies from the Defence Services Command and Staff College in 2001. He’s currently doing his PhD in Environmental Sustainability.

He began his career as a Captain in 1992 with a challenging Demining project in the Gulf War as the Second in Command of an Engineering Demining Company. He played a pivotal role in integrating the Chittagong Hill Tracts (CHT) into the mainstream economy by leading road infrastructure projects. His notable projects include the Bagerhat to Sajek Hilly Road Construction. He was involved in several national-level projects, including the Banani – Airport – Mirpur Multihead Flyover and the Cox’s Bazar Marine Drive. He has made remarkable contributions to the Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) by constructing numerous Border Observation Posts (BOPs) during his service with the BGB from 2012 to 2015. He supervised the rehabilitation project of Malupara in Jashore following the 2014 parliamentary election. In his second UN Peacekeeping Mission, as Commanding Officer of an Engineering Contingent in Mali, he led several road construction projects and airfield development initiatives in the Sahel region of the Sahara Desert. He also led several construction projects in the Bangladesh University of Professionals (BUP) at Mirpur Cantonment.

He emphasises the significance of sustainability in any project. Any project undertaken today should ideally last for years to come, and during that duration, it must be conducive to ecological balance, rather than tampering with it. Being on par with global standards, he reflects concerns over the environmental impact as well as the durability of any plan, and his work and endeavours reflect the same.

He emphasises the importance of proper allocation of resources in any project. Land is one of the scarcest resources in this densely populated country, and he recognises the deep affiliation and ownership associated with it. His works reflect the best utilisation of available resources, ensuring maximum utility. It is often ignored in the realm of business, but he believes that each construction has deeply ideological and personal incentives. Hence, he incorporates sensitivity in each of his tasks. He recognises the monumental effects a personal construction has, and trudges in a way that maximises the welfare of the individuals involved.

He brings in new perspectives and instils grit and mobility in our work culture. With his guidance and supervision, each of our projects is completed with the right blend of efficiency and equity, bringing development and growth.

directors.name: Engr. Md. Abdul Khaleque
bio: Engr. Md. Abdul Khaleque was born in Chapai Nawabganj in the year 1963. He completed his B.Sc. in Engineering degree from RUET between 1980 and 1984. After completing his Graduation, he joined BSCIC as an Assistant Engineer in 1987. After joining BSCIC, he completed his Postgraduate Diploma in Industrial Management (PGDIM) from BIM with a first-class distinction in the year 1993-94. He spent 8 years at the BSCIC headquarters and was appointed to a higher post as an associate faculty Member at SCICT (Basic Training Institute) in 1995. At last, he is working as a Vice Principal (SCIRI) and Chief Engineer of the Civil Engineering Division of BSCIC. He travelled abroad to India, Australia and Saudi Arabia
Arabia. Throughout his long career, he has received numerous awards and accolades.
He is one of the members of the “Institution of Engineers, Bangladesh” (IEB) and a member of “Bangladesh Society for Training & Development” (BSTD).

With his Skilled and contemporary experience in the home and overseas, he has joined Fortress Holdings Ltd. & Fortress Real Estate Ltd. with a genuine commitment to delivering an exceptional, eco-friendly, and cost-effective modern house for home seekers.

directors.name: Md Ariful Islam (Arif)
bio: Md Ariful Islam (Arif) brings over 11 years of strong professional experience, particularly in sales and marketing at Abul Khair Group, the Real estate sector, and client & people relationship management in the financial industry, including 6 years at a multinational company. He joined Fortress Holdings Ltd. and Fortress Real Estate Ltd., one of the leading first land share & real estate companies in Bangladesh. Developing an Innovative strategy and dedicating skilled employees to the work is the central concept by which Fortress Holdings Ltd & Fortress Real Estate Ltd maintain a sustainable business position.

Fortress Holdings Ltd. and Fortress Real Estate Ltd. always believe that you should pursue the opportunities that present themselves first. For that, Fortress Holdings Ltd. and Fortress Real Estate Ltd. are utilising the Diversification process in their business. In the incredible Journey of Human life, Respect, Trust, Commitment, Reliability, Dependability, and Quality are fully reflected in the Fortress Group of Companies.

experts.name: MD. Ahsanul Ferdoush
bio: Ahsanul Ferdoush is a dynamic and results-oriented Team Lead for Sales and Marketing, with a proven track record of driving revenue growth and building high-performing teams.

He excels in developing and executing strategic sales initiatives that capture market share and strengthen brand presence. His leadership is characterized by a focus on mentoring his team to exceed targets and deliver exceptional customer experiences.
A skilled strategist, Ahsanul effectively bridges the gap between the sales force and marketing campaigns, ensuring alignment to achieve overarching business objectives.

awards.title: ISO Certified Company
awards.description: Fortress Group is proud to be an ISO certified company, a testament to our unwavering commitment to quality, consistency, and customer satisfaction. This internationally recognized certification validates that our management systems, operational processes, and service delivery meet the highest global standards of excellence. It means our clients can have complete confidence that they are partnering with an organization dedicated to continuous improvement and operational rigor in everything we do.
